title: A role resolves a base merge whose conflicts touch both test and product files
why: No role may resolve a base merge whose conflicts touch both test and product files, so the orchestrator resolved one by hand on PR #1619 (coordinator, 17:05 CST Nov 7). That breaks roles-orchestrator-never-builds.
note: Done check: a mixed-conflict merge goes to a named role, with no orchestrator edit.
